title: devexp-standup-2026-04-08
content:
Attendees: Jordan Kim (owner), Aisha Patel, Miguel Torres, Li Wei, Priya Nair

Agenda:
- Rapid round of updates (SDKs, docs, samples, quickstarts)
- Blockers and CI/status updates
- Release plan for SDK 0.12.0 quickstart bundle
- Action items and next steps

Notes / Updates:
1) Jordan - SDK release and packaging
- Cut RC for redwood-js SDK (0.12.0-rc1) yesterday. Basic generation + streaming tests green locally, but CI flakey on macOS runners (timeouts on stream closing).
- Plan: hold release until we have one clean CI run or can reproduce locally. Target GA next Tue (2026-04-14) if no regressions.
- Need one more doc page for "streaming best practices" (small how-to + snippet + caveats). Aisha to draft.

2) Aisha - Docs and quickstarts
- Quickstart repo now has three templates: node-chat, python-embeddings, and rerank-sample. Still missing README checklist and telemetry snippet.
- Working with SRE on prod sampling of quickstart telemetry to ensure no PII. Meeting w/ SRE Friday.
- Drafted streaming best-practices doc (WIP). Will post PR against docs site by EOD Friday.

3) Miguel - Samples and sample-app infra
- Sample app for node-chat updated to the new SDK API surface (messages -> envelopes). Manual smoke tests passed.
- Broken: sample-app GitHub Actions failing on matrix job for node 18 due to dependency mismatch with ws@8.4. Fix in PR #210 (should be merged today).
- Plan to add a "deploy to Vercel" quickstart card once GH Actions stable.

4) Li - Telemetry + test harness
- End-to-end harness now captures token counts and latency per model. Seeing 95th-percentile burst latency spikes when running concurrency>8 on small GPU instances. Suspect batching config mismatch in Dedicated sim.
- Action: create a lightweight repro script to share with serving-runtime (PR INF-2371).

5) Priya - Developer tooling + CLI
- CLI v0.7.1 candidate includes login improvements and better error messages for rate-limit responses. Needs docs update on token-refresh flow.
- Noted user confusion around "model aliasing" vs "model pin" in CLI; propose small UX doc and CLI help strings change.

Blockers / Risks:
- CI flakiness on macOS streaming tests blocking GA of SDK 0.12.0. Investigate runner resource limitations or test timeout thresholds. (Owner: Jordan + Miguel)
- Sample app GH Actions failing on Node matrix until ws dep pinned. (Owner: Miguel)
- Batching config mismatch causing latency spikes in sim; needs engagement with serving-runtime team. (Owner: Li)
- Docs review backlog: three outstanding PRs waiting for TA review (Aisha flagged). Need 1-2 reviewers from product/docs.

Decisions:
- Hold GA release until a clean CI run OR agreement to backport a test timeout bump. If neither by EOD Monday, we do a targeted release that excludes the flaky test.
- Merge sample-app dependency pinning ASAP to unblock quickstart card.

Action Items (owner, due):
- Aisha: PR streaming best-practices doc -> docs site (2026-04-10)
- Jordan & Miguel: Reproduce macOS streaming CI flake locally / open infra ticket if needed (2026-04-09)
- Miguel: Merge ws pin PR #210 and re-run sample-app workflow (2026-04-08)
- Li: Create repro script + INF-2371 linking telemetry results to runtime (2026-04-09)
- Priya: Update CLI docs on token-refresh & add CLI help UX doc (2026-04-12)
- Team: Schedule 30-min cross-team sync with serving-runtime and SRE to discuss batching + latency (tentative 2026-04-13)

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider experimental quickstart "devbox" image for local users (preinstalled SDK + creds stub) to reduce onboarding friction. Low effort MVP could be a Dockerfile + instructions.
- Add a small telemetry consent opt-in card to quickstarts to make sampling explicit.

Links referenced:
- SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/482
- Sample-app PR (deps): https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/210
- Jira: INF-2345 (quickstarts backlog), INF-2371 (telemetry repro)
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-DEVEXP-quickstarts (quickstart spec)

Next meeting: Weekly standup Thursday 2026-04-15 10:30-11:00 PT

End of notes.
